d82d6557-6e6b-47bb-87b4-04dd928def2d.last_summary: Taught the Strategy/Adapter pattern and Rust fundamentals (vs. Java), then built a real Scanner/ScannerRegistry pipeline and switched the WorkingStore from raw rusqlite to Diesel (weighed ORM overhead vs. maintainability in depth first). Iterated the DBML schema through several rounds of real design pushback: rejected devices/users/user_devices as premature multi-device complexity, settled on single-user/single-machine scope for v1 with a minimal single-row local_identity table (platform_UUID, device_name, username, chip/memory/os attributes), and worked out how change-detection (device_tools vs. change_events/checkpoints) and future multi-device merging would need to work if ever built. Verified everything live against the real /Applications folder and the real local_identity resolution (system_profiler + whoami + sysinfo), and committed the working Applications-scanner + Diesel store in two commits.
d82d6557-6e6b-47bb-87b4-04dd928def2d.last_next_steps: Add a second scanner (Homebrew Cellar/Cask) to prove the registry handles multiple sources for real. The change_events/checkpoints event-sourcing design and the privacy/visibility_override mechanism are still fully unbuilt. Commit the local_identity migration + identity.rs (done in-session but not yet committed to git).
